svg.text: Olympus E-PM2 v1.6, firmware block 0 (13.5 MiB) with the current patch stack
Address order, left to right, top to bottom. One cell = 256 bytes; one row = 64 KiB. A cell shows the most important thing inside it, so small patches are visible.
changed by the interval patches: 4,389 B
changed by the film patches: 22.7 KiB
blank or reclaimable, not proven: 92.7 KiB
content never loaded to RAM: 18 B
Free and unproven areas come from docs/code-space-map.tsv (tools/freespace.py). Code vs data follows the function database, so tables inside code pages show as code.
